name: Tsuki Silver
description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small silver jewellery atelier, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Moonstone blush paper, muted rose panels, ink text and soft silver reflections; Sorts Mill Goudy for display, Questrial for text. A floating pearl pill header (H10) with the wordmark, menu, account and cart. The home page puts the pieces first (L11): a short title and the five product families marked by moon phases drawn in CSS (new, crescent, half, gibbous, full), then straight into a rhythmic grid of pieces on pale stone (a 2 x 2 feature, pairs of squares and one wide tile), the atelier, sizing and care, the journal and the letter. Ring sizing (four ways, a US size table, free resizing) and Care (four habits, what silver dislikes, free re-polishing) pages; atelier, journal, newsletter and contact pages. The footer (F12) is a stamped round seal and a vertical line of italic text beside the wordmark, the menu and the visit rows of the synced atelier card. The address, hours, telephone, email and the sizing and care notes live in one synced pattern used by the footer, Ring sizing, Care and Contact; every product shows its metal line, kept once as a product attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the home grid and the shop page show the synced tray and orders go by email).
deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H10 + F12 + L11 are as planned (combination unused: Kaori Cosme is H10/F3/L1, Hikari App H10/F2/L6, Kami no Ne H3/F12/L8, Menya Kaen H11/F12/L7, Komugi Pan H2/F8/L11, Ginrin Cycle H6/F10/L11). Muted rose #A07873 is 3.5:1 on blush (2.8:1 on the rose panel), so it is kept to moon marks, hairlines and large marks; links, labels, italic heading accents and the seal use deep rose #6E4E4A (6.6:1 on blush, 5.2:1 on the rose panel), secondary text quiet ink #5E5455 (6.5:1 on blush, 5.2:1 on the rose panel); ink #2E2A2A is 12.7:1 on blush. Pearl #FBF8F7 cards, soft silver #C9C1BF hairlines and pale rose #D9BDB8 were added. H10 differs from Kaori Cosme and Hikari App by a pearl pill with a silver edge, a crescent mark before a Goudy wordmark, centred spaced-capital menu and a rose cart chip; on phones wordmark, Menu and cart stay on one line inside the pill. F12 differs from Kami no Ne and Menya Kaen by a round SVG seal (ring text and a crescent, tilted like a stamp) in deep rose beside a vertical italic line on the muted rose panel. L11 differs from Komugi Pan and Ginrin Cycle by a moon-phase category index under a short title and a four-column grid on pale stone with a 2 x 2 feature tile and a wide tile every eight pieces, a silver sheen on hover (none with reduced motion). Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/sortsmillgoudy, ofl/questrial) and subset to Latin WOFF2 (~83 KB). The Care page uses the existing generic page tag care-guide (the existing tag care is labelled Knife care); the page itself is /care/. Industry silver-jewellery and page tag ring-sizing are new. The eighth product photo (Waning Dome Ring) is a crop of the atelier bench photograph. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, product names, the vertical footer line and the menu on phones
text: body, labels, the menu, prices, buttons and forms

store.withoutPlugin: The home grid and the shop page show the synced silver tray with photographs, metal lines, prices and an editable badge, and orders go by email; store templates are not used.
